entry.summary: Visa-free Schengen short stay for Australians; 90 days in any 180-day period.
entry.pre_arrival: Check the Greek mission, Schengen day count, invitation and any local work days.
entry.max_stay: Short stay is the fast key; residence and work routes need preparation.

tourism.detail: Australians are generally visa-exempt for short Schengen visits.
tourism.next: Check Greece's current visa and border page before travel.

meetings.detail: Meetings, negotiations, fairs and business conferences can fit a visitor stay when no Greek work is performed.
meetings.next: Carry invitation and proof of business purpose.

conference.detail: Attending a congress or seminar is not the same as being paid to deliver the programme.
conference.next: Confirm speaker, trainer, panellist and exhibitor duties separately.

unpaid-speaking.detail: Free speaking or cultural exchange can still be work-like; the exact invitation, expense support and host institution matter.
unpaid-speaking.next: Ask the Greek host to confirm the required category in writing.

paid-speaking.route: Greek work authorisation/residence or host contract
paid-speaking.detail: Paid speaking, consulting and training for a Greek entity need the matching work basis; visitor entry is not a general work permit.
paid-speaking.next: Have the host identify the permit and payroll/tax treatment.

book-launch.detail: Rights meetings can be business travel; launch talks, readings, signings, workshops and local retail need host-led classification.
book-launch.next: Separate fee, royalties, expenses and sales.

ai-teaching.detail: Academic exchange and commercial AI workshops can fall into different Greek categories.
ai-teaching.next: Ask the institution/client to state appointment, pay and duration.

remote-work.detail: Greece publishes a digital-nomad residence pathway for remote work for employers/clients outside Greece, subject to current income and documentation conditions.
remote-work.next: Check the current ministry checklist and avoid Greek client work under the remote route.

entrepreneur.route: Investor, startup or other residence route
entrepreneur.detail: Longer founder activity is a residence and company question, not a tourist extension; current investment and startup programmes must be checked.
entrepreneur.next: Choose the project and confirm the current residence category with Migration/Enterprise Greece.

trade.route: Short business visit; local Greek trading needs status
trade.detail: Negotiation, sourcing and fairs can be visitor activity; local sales, installation or service delivery may trigger permission.
trade.next: Map the Greek contracting party and on-site work.

artist.detail: Performance, filming, exhibition and literary work need promoter and authority classification.
artist.next: State venue, producer, fee, royalties and dates.

mixed-mission.route: Schengen visit plus host or digital-nomad activation
mixed-mission.detail: Greece can be a sudden arrival or a longer foreign-remote base, but local delivery remains a separate key.
mixed-mission.next: Split the itinerary into visitor, foreign remote work and Greek activity.
